chunks: May Allah reward you, people of Egypt, on behalf of a member of your Prophet's family, with the best reward that He gives to those who work in obedience to Him, and to those who are grateful for His blessings, for indeed you heard (me) and obeyed, and when you were called you responded.

key_terms.الشَّاكِرِينَ لِنِعْمَتِهِ: Those who are grateful for His blessings
key_terms.الْعَامِلِينَ بِطَاعَتِهِ: Those who act in obedience to Him

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say to the people of Egypt in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Delivered shortly after the Battle of the Camel, this address highlights the strategic importance of Egypt as a loyal base of support for Imam Ali against internal dissent. The Imam specifically praises their prompt obedience (tabi'ah) and gratitude (shukr) to the Ahl al-Bayt, framing their political allegiance as an act of religious devotion. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the continuity of leadership from the Prophet through his Household, with Egypt serving as a key pillar of legitimacy during the early Caliphate.
